description: CrlChecker<V> and OcspChecker<V> store Vec<u8>, u64, and V. All three types are Clone/Debug when V: Clone + Debug. Neither struct derives Clone or Debug today. A user who wants to log a checker, clone it for parallel use, or put it in a struct that needs Debug will hit a dead end. Fix: add #[derive(Clone, Debug)] — the derives work because Vec<u8> and u64 are Clone+Debug, and V is bounded by the trait impl.
title: CrlChecker and OcspChecker missing Clone/Debug derives
